claim: At $1.9 billion, Costco's net income in fiscal 2024 Q2 was a record.
summary: Costco's actual fiscal 2024 Q2 net income was ~$1.74B, not $1.9B, and was not an all-time record because prior quarters such as fiscal 2023 Q4 were higher.

sub_claims.text: Costco's net income in fiscal 2024 Q2 was $1.9 billion
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge: Costco reported fiscal 2024 Q2 (quarter ended Feb 18, 2024) net income of ~$1.743 billion, not $1.9 billion.

sub_claims.text: Costco's net income in fiscal 2024 Q2 was a record high
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge: Neither $1.9 billion nor the actual ~$1.743 billion was an all-time record; prior quarter fiscal 2023 Q4 net income was ~$2.16 billion, which is higher.
